name: One of Won Won -The One of Wonwon-
original_name: わんおぶわんわん-THE ONE OF WONWON-
source:
Main heroine's ex-boyfriend invites her to visit a dog God shrine. But when they arrive there, he starts to behave mean and claims that person who argues in front of the shrine will turn into a dog. And of course they quarrel over a trifle, and boy turns into a dog. Heroine visits people linked with the shrine to find a cure for the boy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角的前男友邀请她参观狗神社。但当他们到达那里时，他开始表现得很卑鄙，并声称在神社前争论的人会变成狗。当然，他们会因为一点小事而争吵，男孩变成了狗。女主人公拜访了与神社有联系的人，为男孩寻找治疗方法。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
